_provenance: Broadcast-corpus target identity for Method 1/2 personalization ingestion (Stage 6). Matching order: exact FIDE ID first (the raw PGN's WhiteFideId/BlackFideId header, compared as an exact string against fide_id below), exact-string alias fallback second (used only when that side's FIDE ID header is missing/blank). This is a manually curated mapping for exactly these 8 players against this exact corpus, not a general-purpose name resolver -- runtime matching stays plain exact-string comparison, never fuzzy/substring/heuristic. Aliases were curated (2026-09-09 pass) against /home/cotenthusiast/Data/lichess_broadcasts/ under a relaxed evidence standard: an exact string is included when the total corpus/audit evidence makes its identity unambiguous for these 8 people, via any of -- direct FIDE-ID co-occurrence; repeated use in named elite events (event/round/study headers) where the roster is unambiguous; repeated games against other already-verified cohort members; an obvious formatting variant of an already-verified full name (title prefix, name order, doubled whitespace, punctuation, concatenation, country/federation code); or a known online handle the audit's own FIDE-ID clustering ties unambiguously to the target with no conflicting FIDE ID anywhere in the corpus. A handful of strings that visually resemble a target but plausibly name a different real person (e.g. 'Magnus Øen Carlsen', a distinct middle name with no corroborating evidence) were deliberately excluded -- false positives remain unacceptable even under this relaxed standard. canonical_name is a provenance label only and is never matched directly.
